niche: a county jail planning unit's 2027 forecast of felony probation revocation admissions, and the violator pods to staff, after a state act caps felony probation at 24 months and ends every longer running term on 31 March 2027, when probation officers file a violation petition in the weeks before a term lapses on cases with an unresolved matter so the court keeps jurisdiction
answer: draft at the draw: staff six violator pods for 2027, the plan carrying about 950 felony probation revocation admissions (figures set at stage 3)
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the two case-management layouts, the petitions and the Detention Center's revocation commitments, applies SB 26-118 to every felony term and fits the field's survival model of revocation by month on supervision with the risk score, then carries it over each case's 2027 months to its new end and adds new starts on 24-month terms, files about 450 admissions (three pods, a fall of a third) against the golden's about 950 (six pods); persistence files about 700 (four pods).
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the 2027 count of felony probation revocations, forecast from the supervision record the way the field forecasts failure on supervision (a hazard by time on supervision and risk, conversion of violations to revocations, the filing-to-commitment lag), and it turns on a fact of probation law and practice: a violation petition filed before a term expires keeps the court's jurisdiction, so officers file on unresolved matters in the weeks before each scheduled expiration and that clock, not the time since start, carries a fifth of all petitions.

invented_names: Senate Bill 26-118, the Felony Probation Term Act

driver: Failures are filed at two moments of each unit's term, early on and at a review held as the term lapses, so the failure rate by time since entry carries a spike at each term's own end; a cap that moves every term's end earlier moves the review with it and fires it at once for every unit already past the cap, while a forecast that truncates the time-since-entry curve at the cap drops the spike and files a fall.
driver_concrete: Okelan County's probation officers file a violation petition in the last weeks before a felony term lapses on cases with an unresolved matter, so the court keeps jurisdiction; SB 26-118 ends every running term already past 24 months on 31 March 2027 and caps the rest at 24 months, so those petitions fire for some 3,000 terms in the first quarter and at 24 months for the rest, while a revocation hazard by month on supervision, truncated at the new ends, files a fall.
stump: A competent solver fits revocation by month on supervision with the risk score, carries it over each felony case's 2027 months to its new end under SB 26-118 and files about 450 admissions (three pods); the step that lands it there is reading every petition on the time-since-start clock, when about a fifth are filed in the last weeks before a term lapses, ride each term's scheduled end, and under the Act fire at once for the terms that end on 31 March 2027, so the plan carries about 950 (six pods).

differentiation.task152: task152 attributes a solar plant's decline at a module replacement to wear the replacement removes against dust it keeps; here nothing is replaced or decomposed: events tied to each term's scheduled end move with the end a statute sets, and fire together for the terms the statute ends on one day.

lineage.fate: spent, FAILED_TO_STUMP on the portal: both responses landed the call
lineage.driver: Outcomes are recorded only for the units a decision-maker let through, and the decision-makers, who sit by rota and so meet like caseloads, let through very different shares; a rule that lets every unit at a level through has to be priced at the rate the whole level would show, read from how outcomes per unit rise with each decision-maker's let-through share out to all let through, while any rate, model or reweighting fitted on the units already let through keeps the decision-makers' own selection and understates it.

lineage.fate: superseded at stage 2 on 2026-10-27 at the author's instruction (oviya1301): precut one FAIL short, the asks not yet redrawn; the decisive construction (a release joined to the booking that follows it by person and date, then a sum of midnight counts) is one join and a sum once seen, so the stump rested on noticing the join
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a net figure whose offsetting term is provisioned in records filed under a different key, a different case and a category the decision's own eligibility rule excludes, so a pipeline that prices the decision on each unit's own record files a figure several times too large and inverts which levels are the cheapest to act on.
lineage.niche: a county jail's forward bed-day bill for the pretrial releases it already makes: how many detention bed-days the defendants released on a written promise at first appearance will cost the jail next year through the custody that follows a failure to appear, when that custody arrives under a new booking number on a new case on charges the release policy's own eligibility list excludes
lineage.stump: The analyst prices next year's releases at the bed-days of the released defendants' own short stays, projects that forward and files a figure about a quarter of the golden, because the custody that follows a failure to appear sits under new booking numbers on charges the eligibility list excludes and runs about 6 bed-days per failure at the lowest assessment score rising to about 19 at the highest.
